background.rationale: All settings are authored: zero fixes an arbitrary depth origin; the shallow mixed-curvature warp avoids a constant-depth extrusion without assigning image luminance to depth. Radius records the 112 arcminute frame half width; background is not a measured front or a finite cloud mask.

features.rationale: Published topology motivates a localized deformation near this observed sky anchor. The 300 arcsecond circular window, negative z offset, curvature, thickness and 65 percent blend are authored. This changes one front only; it neither reconstructs a separate shell nor models absorption or a true empty cavity. Lens material never chooses the depth.

interpretation: Authored coherent height-surface experiment with three topology-inspired local deformations. Sky anchors are observed; all unmeasured depth, gradient, curvature, thickness and strength choices remain authored. The background is unconstrained. Only one surface exists per sightline: overlapping shells, disconnected fronts, foreground extinction and true cavities are unsupported. No published velocity, density, distance or extinction measurement is fitted; no Helix expansion law or Homunculus geometry is transferred. All source lenses share the same cloud and compact-light distribution.
